# BTicino C300X Integration v1.2.2

This is a Home Assistant integration and native C300X device-agent update focused
on local media-user recovery and clearer user guidance.

## Added

- Adds an optional local Home Call ringback tone in the bundled Home Call card
  while Home Assistant waits for the C300X to answer.

## Fixed

- Updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.2.2`.
- Bootstraps the local Home Assistant media-user files when no usable existing
  media identity is present.
- Uses the dedicated Home Assistant media user as the required local media
  identity for Ring Call and Home Call media setup.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant before testing Ring
  Call or Home Call media-user setup.
